title: GraphPFN: A Prior-Data Fitted Graph Foundation Model
abstract: arXiv:2509.21489v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Graph foundation models face several fundamental challenges including transferability across diverse domains and data scarcity, which calls into question the very feasibility of creating such models. However, despite similar challenges, the tabular domain has recently witnessed the emergence of the first successful foundation models such as TabPFN. These models are based on the prior-data fitted networks (PFN) framework, in which models are pretrained on carefully designed synthetic datasets to make predictions in an in-context learning setting. Recently, G2T-FM, a framework that converts graph node-level tasks into tabular tasks, has made the first step towards adopting PFNs for graphs, yet it is limited to hand-crafted features and was never pretrained on graph data. translated_title: GraphPFN：一种基于先验数据拟合的图基础模型
translated_abstract: 图基础模型面临多项根本性挑战，包括跨不同领域的可迁移性和数据稀缺性，这使创建此类模型的可行性受到质疑。然而，尽管存在类似挑战，表格领域最近已出现了首批成功的基础模型，如TabPFN。这些模型基于先验数据拟合网络（PFN）框架，在该框架中，模型在精心设计的合成数据集上进行预训练，以在上下文学习环境中进行预测。近期，G2T-FM框架将图节点级任务转换为表格任务，迈出了将PFN应用于图的第一步，但它仅限于手工特征，且从未在图数据上进行预训练。在本工作中，我们迈出下一步，提出GraphPFN，这是一种专门为图节点级任务设计和预训练的基于PFN的模型。遵循PFN框架...
tldr: 本文提出GraphPFN，一种专门为图节点级任务设计和预训练的图基础模型，通过PFN框架在合成数据上预训练，解决了图领域的迁移性和数据稀缺问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes GraphPFN, a PFN-based graph foundation model designed and pretrained specifically for node-level tasks, addressing transferability and data scarcity by pretraining on synthetic data within the PFN framework.
